notes: «جميعا عن إسماعيل بن جعفر»: three co-transmitters in one level, one route
«- قال ابن أيوب حدثنا إسماعيل، -» is an editor's variant wording of the first link, not a second route: left out
the story after «قالت» is the narrator's own account with no further isnad; the Prophet is the end
